content:
Perfection is not a motto or a confession it is the manifestation of Christ in His fullness. One cannot pray or meditate their way into Perfection, Christ is the fullness of God revealed and manifested as He is. This is the doing of God the Father by the Resurrection Power of the Holy Spirit! The same power that raised Jesus from the dead. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Possibilty is the revelation of God's reality that man has grasped and manifested on the Earth. With God all things are possible, what is termed as a miracle or wonder, is just an experience of His Person invading the natural world. In the Kingdom, God's reign is the experience of all creation, His reality is the present manifested ordeal in all things, that which is Perfect is come.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Kingdom of God is everlasting in it's expanse, this in turn ties in with the truth that a finite man cannot establish the infinite Kingdom of God! God in Christ Jesus has brought us into the fullness of God in Christ; Perfection, where we are conformed in to the image of the eternal immortal Son of God, to allow us to manifest the eternal Kingdom of God. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The manifestation of the Kingdom of God is not to get you blessed, prosperous, wealthy or healed, the Kingdom manifests and takes effect after all that has been done and left behind. Perfection is not the point at which one achieves the ultimate holiness and righteousness, Perfection beginnings after that point. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The fullness of life is the person of Jesus Christ, He is the expression of the original purpose of God for all Creation. In Christ, God is manifesting the Perfection that all Creation is called into, a reality above and beyond anything that the time may offer, it is beyond the physical or spirit realm, it is the fullness of all things brought into their Perfect state. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection doesn't not give hope, it is the actualization and manifested experience of what is hoped for. For so long the message has been to find hope in Jesus and to believe that He can change ones situation, however God's desire is not to change situations, He has brought us into Himself that we maybe as He is and experience His truth as reality.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Being Perfect is not a confession, it is not something that one has to believe to receive. Perfection is a state it is the state of the risen Christ, it is the fullness of God made manifest, and the experience of His original intent for all Creation. All things come into Perfection by God own working by the Power of the Holy Spirit. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Original purpose of God is not for us to be His followers, not even was it to make us believers, God desires us to manifest His fullness by bringing us into oneness with Himself. Jesus is the express image of God to all Creation, and the express image of Creation to the divine nature. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

True praise and worship stems from the fullness of a being, as it pours out it's total essence in fulfilment of the original purpose that God assigned to it. Worship has be relegated to mean a song or a well structured statement declaring an attribute of God, however true worship is the manifestation of Christ in all Creation. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Death is not rest, Jesus the Resurrection and the Life is Rest. Rest is coming into the fullness of the Resurrection Life of Jesus Christ by the power of the Holy Spirit. It's time to Rest, where all things are brougtht unto Perfection. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is the reality that God sees for all Creation, anything that is contrary to that is unacceptable and not real. Jesus is the fullness of all things, their reality and true nature, this Perfection; Jesus the risen Christ. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Death of Jesus on the cross defeated sin and death in all things, The Resurrection of Christ is the bringing of all things into Perfection, there is a reality beyond what is experienced, a life of Glory that is the expression of the Kingdom, and the manifestation of Love. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

There is nothing that can be lost in Perfection, when it comes into the fullness of Christ it loses its ability to be broken, lost or corrupted. Jesus is the manifestation of the effect of Perfection on all creation. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is not gained, one doesn't grow into it; rather it is manifested, for it is the manifestation of Christ as He is. We are brought into Perfection by the power of the Holy Spirit; this is coming into the fullness of the resurrection Life of Christ, a permanent experience of oneness with God. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

"For the Kingdom of God is Righteous, Peace and Joy in the Holy Ghost". Most people have lost the essence of Joy when it comes to the experience with God, many are accustomed to hearing about the suffering and hardship that comes with following Christ, but the Truth is the full expression of the Kingdom and Perfection is the manifestation of Joy, an overflowing and fulfilling Joy. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection does not deal with who you are, but rather it is the manifestation of HOW you are, it is the core unchanging truth of Christ manifested and experienced but all things around us. Perfection is coming unto the fullness of Christ and bringing all creation in this reality.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The mindset of Victory is a two edged sword on one hand it causes one to be winning conscious and on the other hand it keeps a person in competition, battle, and fighting mode. To emerge victorious one has to go through some opposition or resistance and overcome it. Perfection is not victory, Perfection is life, it is the experience of complete Rest. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is not a teaching, or a higher doctrine or revelation, Jesus the risen Christ is Perfection; The fulfilment of everything that was promised to man, angels and Creation; God's original intent for all things seen and unseen. That which is Perfect is Come. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus is the Perfection of all creation, All things come together in Him, He is the full functioning of the natural and the spiritual together, He is Heaven and Earth as God designed them to be without separation, He is the removal of the division between spirit, soul and body, He is Oneness. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The nature of God is Oneness, separation is a sign of one not being brought into Perfection yet. We can only seek for what we are not, we can only reach out for a reality that is not how we are. God's original intent for creation is to be one with Himself to Manifest His fullness. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

What can be lost cannot host Perfection; corruption cannot inherit incorruption, mortality cannot inherit immortality. Perfection is the Permanent state of the risen Christ residing in Creation, it is God's original purpose for a thing that cannot be changed or corrupted. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Man is not a product of his own thoughts and desires, we were created by God who is very intentional. What ever you chose to live for, be aware that there is an original intent for your life, that God your loving Father preordained for you to walk in, it is the place of your greatest fulfillment and joy. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

You cannot place a price on Perfection, it is not anything one can pay for, to have God's nature fully manifest and experienced by all creation, cannot spring from a man's desire or motivation. It's the working of the Holy Spirit, it is Him who brings us into the full light of Christ's reality and manifests through us to all Creation.  
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*
